verses.greek: Περὶ δὲ ὧν ἐγράψατε, καλὸν ἀνθρώπῳ γυναικὸς μὴ ἅπτεσθαι·
verses.literal: Concerning now the things about which you wrote It is good for a man a woman not to touch
verses.dgt: Now concerning the things you wrote: “It is good for a man not to touch a woman.”

verses.greek: διὰ δὲ τὰς πορνείας ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἐχέτω, καὶ ἑκάστη τὸν ἴδιον ἄνδρα ἐχέτω.
verses.literal: Because of however the sexual immorality each man the his own wife should have and each woman the her own husband should have.
verses.dgt: But because of sexual immorality, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

verses.greek: τῇ γυναικὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ τὴν ὀφειλὴν ἀποδιδότω, ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ τῷ ἀνδρί.
verses.literal: To the wife the husband the debt should fulfill likewise now also the wife to the husband.
verses.dgt: Let the husband give the wife what is due to her, and likewise also the wife to the husband.

verses.greek: ἡ γυνὴ τοῦ ἰδίου σώματος οὐκ ἐξουσιάζει ἀλλὰ ὁ ἀνήρ· ὁμοίως δὲ καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ τοῦ ἰδίου σώματος οὐκ ἐξουσιάζει ἀλλὰ ἡ γυνή.
verses.literal: The wife the her own body not has authority over but the husband likewise now also the husband the his own body not has authority over but the wife.
verses.dgt: The wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does; likewise also the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

verses.greek: μὴ ἀποστερεῖτε ἀλλήλους, εἰ μήτι ἂν ἐκ συμφώνου πρὸς καιρὸν ἵνα σχολάσητε τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ πάλιν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἦτε, ἵνα μὴ πειράζῃ ὑμᾶς ὁ Σατανᾶς διὰ τὴν ἀκρασίαν ὑμῶν.
verses.literal: Not do deprive one another if surely even when by mutual agreement for a time that you may be devoted the to prayer and again together the same may be so that not may tempt you the Satan through the lack of self-control of you.
verses.dgt: Do not deprive one another, except perhaps by agreement for a time, so that you may devote yourselves to prayer, and then come together again, so that Satan may not tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

verses.greek: τοῦτο δὲ λέγω κατὰ συγγνώμην, οὐ κατʼ ἐπιταγήν.
verses.literal: This now I say by way of concession not by way of command.
verses.dgt: But I say this as a concession, not as a command.

verses.greek: θέλω δὲ πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἶναι ὡς καὶ ἐμαυτόν· ἀλλὰ ἕκαστος ἴδιον ἔχει χάρισμα ἐκ θεοῦ, ὁ μὲν οὕτως, ⸁ὁ δὲ οὕτως.
verses.literal: I wish now all men to be like even myself But each their own has gift from God one has indeed this one however that.
verses.dgt: Yet I wish all people to be as I myself am. But each has their own gift from God, one in this way and another in that way.

verses.greek: Λέγω δὲ τοῖς ἀγάμοις καὶ ταῖς χήραις, καλὸν αὐτοῖς ἐὰν μείνωσιν ὡς κἀγώ·
verses.literal: I say now to the unmarried and to the widows good for them if they shall remain as also I. myself
verses.dgt: But I say to the unmarried and to the widows: it is good for them if they remain as I am.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ οὐκ ἐγκρατεύονται, γαμησάτωσαν, κρεῖττον γάρ ἐστιν γαμῆσαι ἢ πυροῦσθαι.
verses.literal: If however not they have self-control they should marry better for it is to marry than to burn with passion.
verses.dgt: But if they do not exercise self-control, let them marry, for it is better to marry than to burn with passion.

verses.greek: Τοῖς δὲ γεγαμηκόσιν παραγγέλλω, οὐκ ἐγὼ ἀλλὰ ὁ κύριος, γυναῖκα ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς μὴ χωρισθῆναι—
verses.literal: To those now having married I give this charge — not I myself but the Lord — A wife from a husband not is to be separated
verses.dgt: But to the married I give this command—not I, but the Lord—that a wife is not to separate from her husband

verses.greek: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ χωρισθῇ, μενέτω ἄγαμος ἢ τῷ ἀνδρὶ καταλλαγήτω— καὶ ἄνδρα γυναῖκα μὴ ἀφιέναι.
verses.literal: if however indeed she shall be separated she should remain unmarried or to the husband she should be reconciled and a husband a wife not is to send away.
verses.dgt: (but if she does separate, let her remain unmarried or be reconciled to her husband), and a husband is not to divorce his wife.

verses.greek: Τοῖς δὲ λοιποῖς λέγω ἐγώ, οὐχ ὁ κύριος· εἴ τις ἀδελφὸς γυναῖκα ἔχει ἄπιστον, καὶ αὕτη συνευδοκεῖ οἰκεῖν μετʼ αὐτοῦ, μὴ ἀφιέτω αὐτήν·
verses.literal: To the now rest say I myself — not the Lord: If any brother a wife has unbelieving and she consents to dwell with him not he should divorce her
verses.dgt: But to the rest I say—I, not the Lord—if any brother has an unbelieving wife and she agrees to live with him, he must not divorce her.

verses.greek: καὶ γυνὴ εἴ τις ἔχει ἄνδρα ἄπιστον, καὶ οὗτος συνευδοκεῖ οἰκεῖν μετʼ αὐτῆς, μὴ ἀφιέτω τὸν ἄνδρα.
verses.literal: And a woman if any has a husband unbelieving and he consents to dwell with her not she should divorce the husband.
verses.dgt: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he agrees to live with her, she must not divorce her husband.

verses.greek: ἡγίασται γὰρ ὁ ἀνὴρ ὁ ἄπιστος ἐν τῇ γυναικί, καὶ ἡγίασται ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἄπιστος ἐν τῷ ἀδελφῷ· ἐπεὶ ἄρα τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν ἀκάθαρτά ἐστιν, νῦν δὲ ἅγιά ἐστιν.
verses.literal: Has been sanctified for the husband the unbelieving in the wife and has been sanctified the wife the unbelieving in the brother else then the children of you unclean are now however holy they are.
verses.dgt: For the unbelieving husband has been sanctified through the wife, and the unbelieving wife has been sanctified through the brother; otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ ὁ ἄπιστος χωρίζεται, χωριζέσθω· οὐ δεδούλωται ὁ ἀδελφὸς ἢ ἡ ἀδελφὴ ἐν τοῖς τοιούτοις, ἐν δὲ εἰρήνῃ κέκληκεν ἡμᾶς ὁ θεός.
verses.literal: If however the unbeliever separates himself he should separate himself not has bee under bondage the brother or the sister in the such cases Into however peace has called you the God.
verses.dgt: But if the unbeliever separates, let them separate. The brother or the sister is not enslaved in such cases; God has called us in peace.

verses.greek: τί γὰρ οἶδας, γύναι, εἰ τὸν ἄνδρα σώσεις; ἢ τί οἶδας, ἄνερ, εἰ τὴν γυναῖκα σώσεις;
verses.literal: How for know you wife if the husband you will save? Or how know you husband if the wife you will save?
verses.dgt: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

verses.greek: Εἰ μὴ ἑκάστῳ ὡς ἐμέρισεν ὁ κύριος, ἕκαστον ὡς κέκληκεν ὁ θεός, οὕτως περιπατείτω· καὶ οὕτως ἐν ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις πάσαις διατάσσομαι.
verses.literal: only except to each as has assigned the Lord to each as has called the God so he should walk And thus in the churches all I prescribe.
verses.dgt: Only let each person walk as the Lord has assigned to each, as God has called each one. And so I direct in all the assemblies.

verses.greek: περιτετμημένος τις ἐκλήθη; μὴ ἐπισπάσθω· ἐν ἀκροβυστίᾳ κέκληταί τις; μὴ περιτεμνέσθω.
verses.literal: circumcised anyone was called? Not he should become uncircumcised In uncircumcision has been called anyone Not he should d be circumcise.
verses.dgt: Was anyone called while circumcised? Let him not undo his circumcision. Was anyone called while uncircumcised? Let him not be circumcised.

verses.greek: ἡ περιτομὴ οὐδέν ἐστιν, καὶ ἡ ἀκροβυστία οὐδέν ἐστιν, ἀλλὰ τήρησις ἐντολῶν θεοῦ.
verses.literal: the Circumcision no thing is and the uncircumcision no thing is but keeping the commandments of God.
verses.dgt: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but keeping God’s commandments is what matters.

verses.greek: ἕκαστος ἐν τῇ κλήσει ᾗ ἐκλήθη ἐν ταύτῃ μενέτω.
verses.literal: Each in the calling in which he has been called in this he should abide.
verses.dgt: Let each person remain in the calling in which they were called.

verses.greek: Δοῦλος ἐκλήθης; μή σοι μελέτω· ἀλλʼ εἰ καὶ δύνασαι ἐλεύθερος γενέσθαι, μᾶλλον χρῆσαι.
verses.literal: Slave being were you called? not you should it concern but if even you are able free to become rather do take advantage.
verses.dgt: Were you called as a slave? Do not let it concern you. But if you can become free, rather make use of it.

verses.greek: ὁ γὰρ ἐν κυρίῳ κληθεὶς δοῦλος ἀπελεύθερος κυρίου ἐστίν· ὁμοίως ὁ ἐλεύθερος κληθεὶς δοῦλός ἐστιν Χριστοῦ.
verses.literal: The one for in the Lord having been called being a slave a freedman of the Lord is likewise the one free having been called a slave is of Christ.
verses.dgt: For the one called in the Lord as a slave is the Lord’s freed person; likewise, the one called while free is Christ’s slave.

verses.greek: τιμῆς ἠγοράσθητε· μὴ γίνεσθε δοῦλοι ἀνθρώπων.
verses.literal: With a price you were bought not do become slaves of men.
verses.dgt: You were bought with a price; do not become slaves of people.

verses.greek: ἕκαστος ἐν ᾧ ἐκλήθη, ἀδελφοί, ἐν τούτῳ μενέτω παρὰ θεῷ.
verses.literal: Each wherein that he was called brothers in that he should abide with God.
verses.dgt: Brothers and sisters, let each person remain before God in the condition in which they were called.

verses.greek: Περὶ δὲ τῶν παρθένων ἐπιταγὴν κυρίου οὐκ ἔχω, γνώμην δὲ δίδωμι ὡς ἠλεημένος ὑπὸ κυρίου πιστὸς εἶναι.
verses.literal: Concerning now the virgins a commandment of the Lord not I have judgment however I give as received mercy from the Lord trustworthy to be.
verses.dgt: Now concerning virgins, I have no command from the Lord, but I give an opinion as one who has received mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

verses.greek: νομίζω οὖν τοῦτο καλὸν ὑπάρχειν διὰ τὴν ἐνεστῶσαν ἀνάγκην, ὅτι καλὸν ἀνθρώπῳ τὸ οὕτως εἶναι.
verses.literal: I think therefore this good being because of the being present necessity that it is good for a man the in the same manner to remain.
verses.dgt: Therefore I think this is good because of the present distress: it is good for a person to remain as they are.

verses.greek: δέδεσαι γυναικί; μὴ ζήτει λύσιν· λέλυσαι ἀπὸ γυναικός; μὴ ζήτει γυναῖκα·
verses.literal: Have you been bound to a wife? Not do seek to be loosed Have you been loosed from a wife? Not do seek a wife.
verses.dgt: Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek release. Are you released from a wife? Do not seek a wife.

verses.greek: ἐὰν δὲ καὶ γαμήσῃς, οὐχ ἥμαρτες. καὶ ἐὰν γήμῃ ἡ παρθένος, οὐχ ἥμαρτεν. θλῖψιν δὲ τῇ σαρκὶ ἕξουσιν οἱ τοιοῦτοι, ἐγὼ δὲ ὑμῶν φείδομαι.
verses.literal: If however also you shall marry not you did sin and if shall marry the virgin not she did sin tribulation however in the flesh will have the such I myself now you am sparing.
verses.dgt: But even if you marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such people will have affliction in the flesh, and I am trying to spare you.

verses.greek: τοῦτο δέ φημι, ἀδελφοί, ὁ καιρὸς συνεσταλμένος ἐστίν· τὸ λοιπὸν ἵνα καὶ οἱ ἔχοντες γυναῖκας ὡς μὴ ἔχοντες ὦσιν,
verses.literal: This now I say brothers: The season shortened is the From now on that both those having wives as none having may be
verses.dgt: But this I say, brothers and sisters: the time has been shortened. From now on, let even those who have wives be as though they had none,

verses.greek: καὶ οἱ κλαίοντες ὡς μὴ κλαίοντες, καὶ οἱ χαίροντες ὡς μὴ χαίροντες, καὶ οἱ ἀγοράζοντες ὡς μὴ κατέχοντες,
verses.literal: and those weeping as not weeping and those rejoicing as not rejoicing and those buying as not possessing
verses.dgt: and those who weep as though not weeping, and those who rejoice as though not rejoicing, and those who buy as though not possessing,

verses.greek: καὶ οἱ χρώμενοι τὸν κόσμον ὡς μὴ καταχρώμενοι· παράγει γὰρ τὸ σχῆμα τοῦ κόσμου τούτου.
verses.literal: and those using the world as not using it as their own. Is passing away for the present form of the world this
verses.dgt: and those who use the world as though not using it fully, for the form of this world is passing away.

verses.greek: Θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀμερίμνους εἶναι. ὁ ἄγαμος μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ κυρίου, πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῷ κυρίῳ·
verses.literal: I desire now you without concern to be. The unmarried man cares for the things of the Lord how he may please the Lord
verses.dgt: But I want you to be free from concern. The unmarried man is concerned about the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

verses.greek: ὁ δὲ γαμήσας μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ κόσμου, πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῇ γυναικί,
verses.literal: the one however having been married he cares for the things of the world how he may please the wife
verses.dgt: but the married man is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife,

verses.greek: καὶ μεμέρισται. καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ ἄγαμος καὶ ἡ παρθένος μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ κυρίου, ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ τῷ σώματι καὶ ⸁τῷ πνεύματι· ἡ δὲ γαμήσασα μεριμνᾷ τὰ τοῦ κόσμου, πῶς ἀρέσῃ τῷ ἀνδρί.
verses.literal: and has he been divided. And the woman the unmarried and the virgin cares for the things of the Lord that she may be holy both in body and in the spirit the one however having been married she cares for the things of the world how she may please the husband.
verses.dgt: and he is divided. The unmarried woman and the virgin are concerned about the things of the Lord, so that she may be holy both in body and in spirit; but the married woman is concerned about the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

verses.greek: τοῦτο δὲ πρὸς τὸ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν σύμφορον λέγω, οὐχ ἵνα βρόχον ὑμῖν ἐπιβάλω, ἀλλὰ πρὸς τὸ εὔσχημον καὶ εὐπάρεδρον τῷ κυρίῳ ἀπερισπάστως.
verses.literal: This now for the of you yourselves your benefit I say not that a restraint you I may place upon but for what is seemly and devoted to the Lord without distraction.
verses.dgt: I say this for your own benefit, not to put a restraint on you, but for what is proper and for undistracted devotion to the Lord.

verses.greek: Εἰ δέ τις ἀσχημονεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν παρθένον αὐτοῦ νομίζει ἐὰν ᾖ ὑπέρακμος, καὶ οὕτως ὀφείλει γίνεσθαι, ὃ θέλει ποιείτω· οὐχ ἁμαρτάνει· γαμείτωσαν.
verses.literal: If however anyone to be behaving improperly to the virgin of him supposes if she shall be beyond youth and so it ought to be what he wills he should do not he does sin they should marry.
verses.dgt: But if anyone thinks he is acting improperly toward his virgin, if she is past her prime and it ought to be so, let him do what he wishes; he is not sinning. Let them marry.

verses.greek: ὃς δὲ ἕστηκεν ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἑδραῖος μὴ ἔχων ἀνάγκην, ἐξουσίαν δὲ ἔχει περὶ τοῦ ἰδίου θελήματος, καὶ τοῦτο κέκρικεν ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ καρδίᾳ, τηρεῖν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ παρθένον, καλῶς ποιήσει·
verses.literal: He who however has stood in the heart of him firm not having necessity authority however having over the own will and this has judged in the own heart to keep the his own virgin well he will do.
verses.dgt: But the one who stands firm in his heart, having no necessity but having authority over his own will, and has decided this in his own heart, to keep his own virgin, will do well.

verses.greek: ὥστε καὶ ὁ γαμίζων τὴν παρθένον ἑαυτοῦ καλῶς ποιεῖ, καὶ ὁ μὴ ⸁γαμίζων κρεῖσσον ποιήσει.
verses.literal: So then also the one giving in marriage the virgin his own well does and the one not giving in marriage better will do.
verses.dgt: So then, the one who gives his virgin in marriage does well, and the one who does not give her in marriage will do better.

verses.greek: Γυνὴ δέδεται ἐφʼ ὅσον χρόνον ζῇ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς· ἐὰν δὲ κοιμηθῇ ὁ ἀνήρ, ἐλευθέρα ἐστὶν ᾧ θέλει γαμηθῆναι, μόνον ἐν κυρίῳ·
verses.literal: A wife has been bound for as long as time may live the husband of her if however shall have died the husband free she is to whom she wills to be married only in the Lord.
verses.dgt: A wife is bound as long as her husband lives; but if her husband falls asleep in death, she is free to marry whomever she wishes, only in the Lord.

verses.greek: μακαριωτέρα δέ ἐστιν ἐὰν οὕτως μείνῃ, κατὰ τὴν ἐμὴν γνώμην, δοκῶ δὲ κἀγὼ πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἔχειν.
verses.literal: More blessed however she is if in the same manner she shall remain according to the my judgment I think now myself also the Spirit of God to have.
verses.dgt: But she is happier if she remains as she is, according to my opinion; and I think that I too have the Spirit of God.
